review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：检查产物寿命，按授权下载或持久化到约定位置，验证内容并记录长期路径。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_zh: 先小样本验证固定抽取契约
summary_en: Freeze extraction fields and validate a small sample before scaling.
summary_zh: 固定抽取字段，在扩大执行前验证小样本。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Fix schema and null/error rules, test representative pages, inspect results and only scale after the contract is usable. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：固定 schema 与空值/错误规则，测试代表性页面，检查结果后再扩展。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_zh: 编辑前区分替换与局部更新
summary_en: Choose an update method according to whether it replaces or patches content.
summary_zh: 依据工具是整份替换还是局部修改来选择编辑方式。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Inspect tool semantics; use append for additions or read/merge/full payload for a replacement endpoint. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：检查工具语义；增加内容使用 append，整份替换接口则先读、合并、再提交完整内容。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Resolve opaque IDs within their scope
name_zh: 在所属范围解析不透明 ID
summary_en: Translate human names into service IDs while retaining parent scope.
summary_zh: 把人类名称解析成服务 ID，并保留父级范围。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: List the intended parent, resolve task ID inside that parent and pass both identifiers. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：先找到目标父级，再在其中解析任务 ID，提交两者。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Keep an undo ledger for file operations
name_zh: 文件操作保留撤销记录
summary_en: Preserve originals or record reversible source-to-destination moves before reorganizing files.
summary_zh: 整理文件前保留原件，或记录可逆的原路径到目标路径映射。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Prepare a mapping, preserve original data, resolve conflicts and record each completed move/copy. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：先建立映射，保留原始数据，解决名称冲突，逐项记录完成的移动或复制。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_zh: 先展开 schema 引用再构造参数
summary_en: Load a referenced schema before constructing tool arguments.
summary_zh: 工具只返回 schema 引用时，先加载完整定义。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: Fetch the full schema, inspect required fields/types, then construct and validate arguments. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：展开引用，检查必填字段及类型，再构造并校验参数。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Bind actions to the selected tenant
name_zh: 将操作绑定到选定租户
summary_en: Select the intended organization explicitly instead of accepting a first-account default.
summary_zh: 明确选择目标组织，避免默认使用第一个连接账号。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: List connections, match the intended organization and include its tenant_id in subsequent calls. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：列出连接并匹配目标组织，后续调用显式带 tenant_id。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

summary_en: Represent incomplete work with an explicit continuation state: an opaque service cursor for API records, or a self-authored pointer to the next complete generated unit.
summary_zh: 用明确续接状态表达未完成工作：API 记录使用不透明服务游标，生成内容使用自定义的下一完整单元指针。

review.reason_en: Retain the distinct procedure: For API records, pass through the service-issued cursor unchanged and report returned count, known total/remaining count, and truncated/completion state truthfully. For generated output, stop after a complete unit and state the actual completed count, known total or unknown total, and the next unit label; resume there without repeating prior units. These are distinct contracts: an authored unit pointer is not an API token. Its matched-task contrast and explicit limits support editorial admission only.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：API 记录：原样传递服务签发的游标，并如实报告返回数、已知总数/剩余数及截断/完成状态。生成内容：在完整单元后停止，报告实际完成数、已知总数或总数未知，以及下一单元标签；从该处续写且不重复。两类契约不同：自写单元指针不是 API 令牌。 同任务对照及明确边界支持编辑准入，未代表实测效果。

name_en: Identify the actor before inferring intent
name_zh: 判断意图前确认记录发出者
summary_en: Separate human requests from parent-agent dispatches, injected text and tool results.
summary_zh: 区分人类请求、父代理派发、注入文本和工具结果。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Establish record meanings and parent/child relationships, then attribute intent only to records proven to be human-typed. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：先确认记录语义及父子关系，只把证明为人类输入的记录用于意图归因。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Abuse cases beside intended use cases
name_zh: 滥用例与预期用例并列
summary_en: Derive negative scenarios from each trust boundary before selecting controls.
summary_zh: 每信任边界先导负场景再选控制。

sources.section: Abuse cases beside intended use cases

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Name writer, asset and boundary; ask how the intended action can be misused and turn that into a testable failure scenario. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：说明写者资产边界，问预期动作如何被滥用，再变成可测失败场景。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 按声明的产物类型评分
summary_en: Choose the grading evidence according to whether the promised artifact is execution or conversation.
summary_zh: 按承诺产物是执行还是对话选择证据。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Execution cases require real fixture work and tool traces; dialogue cases grade conversational turns only when that is the actual deliverable. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：执行例需真实夹具与工具轨迹；仅真正对话交付才按轮次评分。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Validate kill assumptions before secondary preferences
name_zh: 先验证致命假设再看次要偏好
summary_en: Classify assumptions by what their failure would do to the proposed direction.
summary_zh: 按失败对方向的影响给假设分级。

sources.section: Validate kill assumptions before secondary preferences

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Validate dealbreakers before implementation, important adjustable bets next and secondary optimizations after the core is supported. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：实施前验致命点，再验可调重要赌注，核心有支持后才次要优化。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

summary_en: Claim an action in one operation and bind its identity to the original payload.
summary_zh: 以单操作认领动作，并将身份绑定原载荷。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Use an atomic uniqueness gate before execution; reject a reused key whose canonical payload differs, and define in-flight duplicate behavior. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：执行前原子唯一门控；同键规范载荷不同则拒绝，明确运行中重复行为。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 缓存键包含改变响应的输入
summary_en: Derive a cache key from every input that affects the visible response.
summary_zh: 以所有影响可见响应的输入导出缓存键。

sources.section: Parameters beyond content require a different cache contract
Reuse a shared dependency cache only for matching manifest and lockfile fingerprints; diverged links become independent

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Inventory tenant, viewer permissions, locale and feature state; state staleness/invalidation explicitly and reject reuse across unmatched response contexts. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：清点租户、查看者权限、地区及功能状态，明确陈旧失效策略，不跨不匹配背景复用。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 资源新鲜度与解读相关性
summary_en: A fresh resource validator does not make a previously transformed answer relevant to a different question.
summary_zh: 源验证器确认新鲜，不使旧变换答案适合另一问题。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Record both source version and transformation question; reuse a derived reading only when it covers the new task, otherwise refetch or rederive from raw content. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：同时记录来源版本与变换问题；派生解读覆盖新任务才复用，否则重取或按原文重新解读。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

summary_en: Keep fast feedback near edits and place expensive checks at explicit later gates.
summary_zh: 快速反馈近编辑，昂贵检查在明确后门。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Name each check target, lifecycle phase and cost budget; reuse existing evidence rather than running the same unchanged suite twice. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：为每检查命名目标、阶段和成本，复用已有证据，不重复跑未变整套。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

summary_en: A local lenient reader passing is not proof that the real consumer accepts the same artifact.
summary_zh: 本地宽松读取通过不证明真实消费者接受同产物。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Test the serialized artifact against the consumer grammar or a strict reference parser; retain accepted/rejected controls and explicit unsupported boundaries. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：按消费者语法或严格参考解析器验序列化产物，保留合法非法对照及未支持边界。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Resolve confinement and ownership before destruction
name_zh: 破坏动作前解析范围与所有权
summary_en: A well-formed derived path is a candidate target, not permission to delete it.
summary_zh: 格式正确派生路径只是目标候选，不是删除许可。

sources.section: Resolve confinement and ownership before destruction

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Resolve symlinks, require a strict descendant of an allowed root and prior authenticated ownership evidence; refuse without broader fallback and address check/use races. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：解符号链接，要求允许根的严格后代与事先认证所有权，拒绝且不扩大回退，并处理检查使用竞争。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Exemption authority outside the constrained unit
name_zh: 豁免权在受约束单元之外
summary_en: A unit under validation cannot grant itself an exemption from that validation.
summary_zh: 被验证单元不能给自身验证豁免。

sources.section: Exemption authority outside the constrained unit

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Keep reviewed exemption policy outside the unit, require an owned reason and use exact own-membership checks rather than inherited object keys. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：经审豁免政策在单元外，须负责人理由，用确切自有成员而非继承对象键。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

summary_en: Preserve attempted ideas and their rejection evidence even when the implementation is reverted.
summary_zh: 实现被撤回时仍保留尝试与拒绝依据。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Record idea, baseline/result, verdict and reason; consult that ledger before retrying the same proposal. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：记录想法、基准结果、结论理由，下次相同提案先查台账。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Bind grader results to the full expectation set
name_zh: 评分结果绑定完整期望集
summary_en: Validate grade identities and reconstruct totals from the declared expectation set.
summary_zh: 验证评分身份，按声明期望集重建总数。

sources.section: Bind grader results to the full expectation set

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Require one unique result per canonical expectation ID, retain canonical text and derive counts; reject missing/duplicate IDs or inconsistent integer summaries. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：每规范ID一个唯一结果，保留规范文字并派生计数，拒缺失重复ID或冲突整数摘要。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Review changes to the quality bar itself
name_zh: 评审质量门槛自身变化
summary_en: Review the validator as well as the implementation so green cannot be bought by weakening the contract.
summary_zh: 评审验证器与实现，防止削弱契约换绿。

sources.section: Review changes to the quality bar itself

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Compare baseline thresholds, skipped/deleted tests, removed assertions, suppressions, stubs and new exceptions; require explained scoped exceptions. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：比较基准阈值、跳过删除测试、移除断言、抑制、桩和新例外，例外须解释且限定。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

summary_en: Choose independent reports for a known artifact and interacting investigators for competing causal hypotheses.
summary_zh: 已知产物用独立报告，竞争因果假设用交互调查。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Ask whether the artifact is known or must be found; preserve independent judgments for verdicts, and require falsifiable evidence exchange before investigative convergence. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：先问产物已知还是待找；判断保留独立性，调查收敛前交换可证伪证据。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Reference closure in the received artifact
name_zh: 接收产物中的参考闭包
summary_en: Verify referenced material in the receiver installed layout rather than only the author repository.
summary_zh: 在接收安装布局核参考，而不只作者仓库。

sources.section: Reference closure in the received artifact
Manual installation: tree and ECC-owned namespace
Preserve package-relative resources across installation cache relocation

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: List mandatory references and resolve them from the containing artifact under the shipped/handed-off layout; package or remap missing dependencies. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：清点必需参考，从所在产物在交付布局解析；缺依赖则打包或改映射。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Separate workflow, perspective and entry point
summary_en: Keep domain work in leaf roles and orchestration at the entry point that owns the decision.
summary_zh: 领域工作留叶角色，编排由拥有决策的入口承担。

sources.section: Separate workflow, perspective and entry point

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Distinguish reusable process, reviewer perspective and user-facing command; choose direct invocation for one lens and flat fan-out plus main merge for independent lenses. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：区别可复用流程、评审视角、面向用户命令；单视角直调，多独立视角扁平分发主合并。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

summary_en: Adopt a measured nonregression direction when an arbitrary target would fail the inherited baseline.
summary_zh: 任意目标使继承基准必败时采用实测不退步方向。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Record metric value, measurement conditions, allowed direction and tolerance; compare equivalent runs and update improved baselines. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：记录值、条件、允许方向及容差，比较等价运行，改善时更新基准。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

summary_en: Separate static potential-impact findings from lab, field and trace measurements.
summary_zh: 区分静态潜在影响与实验室、真实用户、轨迹测量。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Select mode from available artifacts, label every populated value with its source kind, and leave unmeasured fields explicitly unmeasured. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：按可用产物选模式，各值标来源类型，未测字段明确未测。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

summary_en: Compare one change under equivalent measurement conditions and require signal beyond normal variance.
summary_zh: 在等价测量条件比较单个变化，并要求超过正常波动。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Keep command, workload and budget constant; repeat measurements, preserve correctness gates and decide against the observed noise range. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：固定命令负载预算，重复测量，保留正确性门，再按噪声范围决定。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

summary_en: A negative routing example must route to its intended owner, not merely avoid one wrong skill.
summary_zh: 负路由例须转到正确归属，不只避开一个错技能。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Name the correct neighboring skill and require it to outrank the rejected candidate with nonzero match. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：命名正确相邻技能，并要求非零匹配且排序高于被拒候选。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

summary_en: Avoid stacking a full meta-router on top of a host that already selects the same skills natively.
summary_zh: 避免原生已选相同技能时再常驻完整元路由。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Detect the actual host discovery capability and choose one active routing authority; keep reusable skills available on demand. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：检测真实发现能力，只选一个有效路由权威，技能按需可用。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Protected content through an editable projection
name_zh: 通过可编辑投影保护内容
summary_en: Keep protected content in an authoritative store while the editing view contains explicit opaque references.
summary_zh: 权威库保留受保护内容，编辑视图含明确不透明引用。

sources.section: Protected content through an editable projection

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Preserve original bytes and identity, edit only the intended projection, then reconstruct and verify protected content and changed surroundings before applying. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：保留原字节身份，仅编辑指定投影，应用前重建并验受护内容与周边变化。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 问题到信号的可观测性
summary_en: Choose instrumentation from the questions an operator must answer.
summary_zh: 按操作人必须回答的问题选择仪表。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Name diagnostic questions first, then map each to an event, aggregate or path trace; omit signals with no declared use. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：先命名诊断问题，再映事件、聚合或路径轨迹，无用途信号省略。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

summary_en: Treat reviewer output as hypotheses and classify against the actual artifact before acting.
summary_zh: 将评审输出视为假设，行动前按实际产物分类。

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Check contract misread first, then actionable defect, accepted tradeoff and context-caused noise; fix the contract before repeating review when it caused the error. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：先查契约误读，再查可行动缺陷、接受权衡、背景噪声；契约致误则先修契约再评审。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_en: Pass review artifacts through inert input channels
name_zh: 通过惰性输入通道传评审产物
summary_en: Preserve artifact text as data when invoking an external reviewer.
summary_zh: 调用外部评审时保持产物文本为数据。

sources.section: Pass review artifacts through inert input channels

review.reason_en: Admit the distinct procedure: Write the full artifact/contract prompt to a file and feed stdin; verify the tool and use a read-only execution boundary. Matched teaching examples and limits support editorial admission, not measured efficacy.
review.reason_zh: 保留独立流程：完整产物契约提示写文件，经标准输入传递；验证工具并用只读边界。 同任务教学对照和边界支持编辑准入，不代表已测得效果。

name_zh: 任务验收与常设就绪门
